content.text:
The implementation and regression tests are complete. Validation passed:
- Both public examples
- Seven focused regression tests
- 4,000 randomized cases against an independent replay model
- 36,000 malformed and resealed wire-frame checks
- 94 illegal-batch checks for the exact error response

The entry point still validates the full batch before compiling, and compilation uses `/workspace/tmp`.

arguments.command: python3 -B project/tests/test_replay.py && python3 public_check.py project/solver.py && find project -not -path '*/__pycache__/*' -not -path '*/build/*' -type f -printf '%p %s bytes %n links\n' | sort && du -sh project
